The '''Dentari sector''' was located in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> It contained the [[Borloria system/Legends|Borloria system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Borlorian]]s,<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Borlorian" /> and the [[Dentaria system/Legends|Dentaria system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the origin point of the beverage known as the [[Dentarian Ripple]].<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]''</ref><ref name="Dentarian">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dentarian Ripple]]|system=Dentaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Dentari [[Sector/Legends|sector]] shared its [[spinward]] border with the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] and its [[trailing]] border with the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey]] and [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sectors]]. Dentari also formed the Expansion Region's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Venaarian sector/Legends|Venaarian sector]] as well as part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dentari sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares O-7 and O-8.<ref name="Expansion" />
